Dutiyakassapasutta With Kassapa (2nd)

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

Ekamantaṁ ṭhito kho kassapo devaputto bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi: Standing to one side, the godling Kassapa spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:

“Bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto, “If a mendicant is a meditator, freed in mind, Ākaṅkhe ce hadayassānupattiṁ; and if they desire the heart’s fulfillment— Lokassa ñatvā udayabbayañca, having known the arising and passing of the world, Sucetaso anissito tadānisaṁso”ti. good-hearted, independent, that is their reward.”
